description: Defines the TransportClientSocketPool class, which manages network socket connections, idle sockets, and request handling within the Chromium networking stack. It includes nested classes for socket requests and socket groups, and handles connection limits, socket reuse, and proxy authentication.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages network socket connections, idle sockets, and request queues, supporting connection limits, socket reuse, and proxy authentication within Chromium.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request
classes.description: Represents a socket request, including handle, callback, priority, socket parameters, and associated connect job.

classes.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Group
classes.description: Represents a group of sockets and requests associated with a specific GroupId, managing active sockets, idle sockets, and pending requests.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request::AssignJob
methods.description: Associates a ConnectJob with the request.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::Request::ReleaseJob
methods.description: Unassigns and returns the current ConnectJob from the request.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a socket pool with a custom ConnectJobFactory for testing purposes.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::RequestSocket
methods.description: Requests a socket for a specific group with given parameters and callback.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::RequestSockets
methods.description: Requests multiple sockets for a specific group.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of a request in a group.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets within a specific group.

methods.name: TransportClientSocketPool::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the load state of a group.
